title: Launch Configuration
description: Pipeline launch configuration: a Beam runner (top-level oneOf) and an execution environment (nested oneOf). The Builder UI renders the launch modal from this schema; the server fills `default` values from its environment (x-launch-default names the LaunchDefaults key).

oneOf.title: Dataflow
oneOf.description: Run pipeline on Google Cloud Dataflow

project.title: Project
project.description: Google Cloud project to run the job in (default: config options.dataflow.project / options.gcp.project, then the server environment)

region.title: Region
region.description: Dataflow region (default: config options.dataflow.region / options.gcp.workerRegion, then the server environment)

oneOf.title: Flex Template
oneOf.description: Launch the deployed dataflow image as a Flex Template job

jobName.title: Job name
jobName.description: Dataflow job name ([-a-z0-9], starting with a letter; other characters are normalised). Default: config options.jobName, then the config name with a timestamp suffix

templateLocation.title: Template location
templateLocation.description: GCS path of the Flex Template spec file (gs://...). Default: config options.dataflow.templateLocation, then MERCARI_PIPELINE_LAUNCH_DATAFLOW_TEMPLATE_LOCATION

serviceAccount.title: Service account
serviceAccount.description: Worker service account email (default: config options.dataflow.serviceAccount, then the server environment)

oneOf.title: In-process (development)
oneOf.description: Build the pipeline in the server JVM and submit it with DataflowRunner (stages the server classpath)

oneOf.title: Direct
oneOf.description: Run pipeline with DirectRunner in a serverless container (the image built with the direct profile)

project.title: Project
project.description: Google Cloud project of the Cloud Run resource (default: config options.gcp.project, then the server environment)

region.title: Region
region.description: Cloud Run region (default: config options.gcp.workerRegion, then the server environment)

oneOf.title: Cloud Run Job
oneOf.description: Execute a pre-created Cloud Run Job (direct image) with this config as its container arguments. The job's image, service account, cpu and memory come from the job definition; see deploy/cloud-run-jobs.md

jobName.title: Job name
jobName.description: Name of the pre-created Cloud Run Job (default: MERCARI_PIPELINE_LAUNCH_DIRECT_JOB)

taskTimeout.title: Task timeout (seconds)
taskTimeout.description: Overrides the job's task timeout for this execution (default: MERCARI_PIPELINE_LAUNCH_DIRECT_TASK_TIMEOUT, then the job's value)

taskCount.title: Task count
taskCount.description: Number of tasks (each runs the same pipeline; keep 1 unless the pipeline shards itself)

env.title: Extra env vars
env.description: Additional container environment variables for this execution, as K=V,K=V

wait.title: Wait (seconds)
wait.description: Wait up to this many seconds for the execution to complete before responding (0 = return immediately)

oneOf.title: Cloud Run Worker Pool
oneOf.description: Deploy the direct image as a Cloud Run Worker Pool running this config (streaming / long-running pipelines). The pool keeps running until you delete it: gcloud run worker-pools delete <name>

name.title: Worker pool name
name.description: Name of the worker pool to create (default: mp-<config name>-<timestamp>)

serviceAccount.title: Service account
serviceAccount.description: Service account the pool runs as (default: the server environment's service account)

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Memory per instance, e.g. 6Gi (default: 6Gi; the JVM heap uses 75% of it)

instances.title: Instances
instances.description: Manual instance count. Each instance runs an independent copy of the pipeline: more than 1 only makes sense for Pub/Sub sources

replaceExisting.title: Replace existing
replaceExisting.description: Deploy a new revision if a worker pool of this name already exists (otherwise the launch fails)

project.title: Project
project.description: Google Cloud project (default: config options.gcp.project, then the server environment)

region.title: Region
region.description: Dataproc region (default: config options.gcp.workerRegion, then the server environment)

jars.title: Jar files
jars.description: GCS path of the bundled pipeline jar (gs://...; default: MERCARI_PIPELINE_LAUNCH_SPARK_JARS)

oneOf.title: Dataproc Serverless
oneOf.description: Submit as a Dataproc Serverless batch

oneOf.title: Flink
oneOf.description: Run pipeline on Flink Runner (not implemented yet)

jars.title: Jar files
jars.description: GCS path to the pipeline jar file (gs://...)
